name: TidyCal
description: TidyCal is a simple, user-friendly scheduling tool designed to streamline the process of booking appointments and meetings. It allows users to set up their availability and share personalized booking links, making it easy for others to schedule time with them. TidyCal integrates with various calendar platforms, such as Google Calendar and Outlook, to automatically sync events and avoid double bookings. It’s popular for its clean interface, customizable settings, and time-saving features for both individuals and teams.
